info.name: Receive the list of creatives and their IDs.

params.name: page_size
params.description: number of creatives per page (default 100, max 10000)

params.name: offset
params.description: Optional page selector RELATIVE to page_token: 1 = next page (the default when a page_token is supplied), -1 = previous page, 0 = reload the current page. Has no effect without page_token.

params.name: page_token
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response's pagination.pageToken. Pass it alone to fetch the next page; pagination is cursor-based and offset defaults to the next page when a page_token is supplied.

params.name: advertiser
params.description: Filter by advertiser organization ID(s). Comma-separated for multiple advertisers.

params.name: statuses
params.description: Filter by creative status. Comma-separated. Values: DRAFT, READY, PAUSED, CANCELLED, ARCHIVED.

params.name: media_types
params.description: Filter by media type. Comma-separated. Values: VIDEO, AUDIO, DISPLAY. OTT is accepted as an alias for VIDEO.

params.name: search
params.description: Typo-tolerant fuzzy text search across creative id, name, vast_url, isci_code, click_thru, oms_id, and ext_id. Results are ranked by match quality.
